```{r setup, include=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warnings=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=5)
```

The code is under GNU GPL-3 license (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html).
The objective of this R Markdown code is to analyse the results obtained by the single cell RNA sequencing.

```{r libraries}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning = FALSE, message = FALSE) 

packages <- c(
  "Seurat",
  "ggplot2",
  "patchwork", # to combine plots
  "dplyr",
  "here",
  # for concave hulls:
  "ggforce",
  "openxlsx",
  "future",    # in this case to stop parallelization
  "CellChat"
)
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
```


Folder structure
```{r}
Datafolder     <- here("Data")
Data_calc <- here("Data_calculated") # Path to find Part 1 and 2 outputs

# Subdirectories specifically isolated for this run's outputs
Figures   <- here(file.path("Figures", "cell_chat"))
Data_calc <- here("Data_calculated")
Results   <- here("Results")

if (!file.exists(Figures))   dir.create(Figures, recursive = TRUE)
if (!file.exists(Data_calc)) dir.create(Data_calc, recursive = TRUE)
if (!file.exists(Results))   dir.create(Results, recursive = TRUE)

utils_file <- here("Rscripts","utils.R")
if (file.exists(utils_file)) source(utils_file)
```

Config parameters and marker lists
```{r}
config_file <- here("Rscripts","config.R")
source(config_file)
```


Read in sample and reference data
```{r}

# ct <- "EpiC"
ct <- "kolf2"

# for checks:
FGF_genes <- list(
"ligands" = c(
  # FGF Ligands
  "FGF1", "FGF2", "FGF3", "FGF4", "FGF5", "FGF6", "FGF7", "FGF8", "FGF9", 
  "FGF10", "FGF11", "FGF12", "FGF13", "FGF14", "FGF16", "FGF17", "FGF18", 
  "FGF19", "FGF20", "FGF21", "FGF22", "FGF23"),
"receptors"= c(
  # FGF Receptors
  "FGFR1", "FGFR2", "FGFR3", "FGFR4"
))

EGF_genes <- list(
"ligands" = c(
  # EGF Ligands
  "EGF", "HBEGF", "TGFA", "EREG", "BTC", "AREG", "EPGN", "NRG1", "NRG2", 
  "NRG3", "NRG4"
),
"receptors" = c(
  # EGF Receptors
  "EGFR", "ERBB2", "ERBB3", "ERBB4"
))

FGF_EGF <- list("FGF"=FGF_genes, "EGF"=EGF_genes)

# for (ct in c("EpiC", "kolf2")){
  
# use the new cluster names
outfile <- file.path(Results, paste("seu_integrated_clusters_newnames_", ct, "_all_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".rds", sep=""))
seu.integrated <- LoadSeuratRds(outfile)
# for the nice plots, remove "type_12" cluster
seu.integrated <- subset(seu.integrated, subset = !cluster_type %in% c("type_12"))
seu.integrated$cluster_type <- droplevels(seu.integrated$cluster_type)
# write out cell numbers
table(seu.integrated$sample.names, seu.integrated$cluster_type)
    
day_options <- c("D42_hTH")
for (day in day_options){
    seu.day <- subset_seu_by_day(seu.integrated, day)
      
    # drop unused levels - do it everywhere!!!
    cluster_sizes <- table(seu.day$cluster_type)
    keep_clusters <- names(cluster_sizes[cluster_sizes >= drop_clusters])
    seu.day <- subset(seu.day, subset = cluster_type %in% keep_clusters)
    if (ct=="kolf2" & (day=="D42_hTH" | day=="D42_both")){
      seu.day <- subset(seu.day, subset = !cluster_type %in% drop_in_hTH)
    }
    
    # set up the order
    bio_order <- bio_order_list[[ct]]
    seu.day$cluster_type <- droplevels(seu.day$cluster_type)
   
    # use new names
    actual_day <- limma::strsplit2(day, "_")[[1]]
    
    # Rename clusters from previous annotation
    if (actual_day %in% names(cluster_names_dict[[ct]])){
          new_cluster_ids <- dplyr::recode(
        as.character(seu.day$cluster_type),
        !!!cluster_names_dict[[ct]][[actual_day]]
      )
      # Preserve cluster order
      renamed_cluster_order <- dplyr::recode(
        bio_order,
        !!!cluster_names_dict[[ct]][[actual_day]]
      )
      
      new_cluster_ids <- factor(
        new_cluster_ids,
        levels = unique(renamed_cluster_order)
      )
      
      # Store back into Seurat object and construct final legend text
      seu.day$cluster_type_renamed <- new_cluster_ids
      Idents(seu.day) <- "cluster_type_renamed"
    }
    
    # drop unused levels
    seu.day$cluster_type_renamed <- droplevels(seu.day$cluster_type_renamed)
    
    
    # #---------------
    # # Add an artificial "medium" cluster expressing EGF and FGF1 to model ligand availability from the culture medium during CellChat analysis.
    # n_dummy <- 50
    # dummy_data <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(seu.day), ncol = n_dummy)
    # rownames(dummy_data) <- rownames(seu.day)
    # colnames(dummy_data) <- paste0("medium_", 1:n_dummy)

    # genes_to_check <- c("EGF", "EGF1", "FGF", "FGF1")

    # my.rna <- GetAssayData(seu.day, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
    # if ("FGF1" %in% rownames(my.rna)){
    #   fgf1_expression <- my.rna["FGF1", ]
    #   summary(fgf1_expression) }
    # #egf_expression <- GetAssayData(object = seu.day, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")["EGF", ]
    # if ("EGF" %in% rownames(my.rna)){
    #   egf_expression <- my.rna["FGF1", ]
    #   summary(egf_expression) }
    # dummy_data["FGF1", ] <- 0.002
    # dummy_data["EGF", ] <- 0.002  
    # 
    # # 3. Merge this into your existing Seurat object
    # medium_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = dummy_data, project = "medium")
    # medium_obj <- NormalizeData(medium_obj)
    # medium_obj$cluster_type_renamed <- "medium"
    # 
    # # Merge with your original object
    # seu.combined <- merge(seu.day, y = medium_obj)
    # seu.combined <- NormalizeData(seu.combined, assay = "RNA")
    # DefaultAssay(seu.combined) <- "RNA"
    # seu.combined <- JoinLayers(seu.combined)
    # 
    # # Extract the dummy cell names
    # dummy_cells <- colnames(medium_obj)
    # rna_data <- GetAssayData(seu.combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
    # 
    # # Set them to 2.0 (matching the max of your real data summaries)
    # rna_data["EGF", dummy_cells] <- 2.0
    # rna_data["FGF1", dummy_cells] <- 2.0
    # 
    # # Update the Seurat object with the capped matrix
    # seu.combined <- SetAssayData(seu.combined, assay = "RNA", layer = "data", new.data = rna_data)
    # 
    # 
    # # set order 
    # seu.combined$cluster_type_renamed <- factor(
    #   seu.combined$cluster_type_renamed,
    #     levels = c(levels(seu.day$cluster_type_renamed), "medium")
    #   )
    # 
    # # Set identities and plot
    # Idents(seu.combined) <- "cluster_type_renamed"
    # 
    # # p_check <- DotPlot(seu.combined, features = c(EGF_ligands, FGF_ligands), assay = "RNA")
    # # p_check$data <- p_check$data[p_check$data$pct.exp > 0, ] # remove zero percent dots!
    # # print(p_check)
    # 
    # # for simplicity rename to seu.day
    # seu.day <- seu.combined
    
    
    Idents(seu.day) <- "cluster_type_renamed"
    DefaultAssay(seu.day) <- "RNA"
    
    #-----------
    
    # some checks:
    # p1 <- DotPlot(seu.day, features=EGF_receptors)
    # p2 <- DotPlot(seu.day, features=EGF_ligands)
    # both <- p1 | p2
    
    for (current_list_name in names(FGF_EGF)){
      current_list <- FGF_EGF[[current_list_name]]
      p_dot <- DotPlot(
        seu.day,
        features = current_list, 
        cols = c("lightgrey", "red"),
        col.min = 0,
        dot.scale = 6,
        assay = "RNA"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) abbrev_dict[x]) +
      RotatedAxis() + 
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
        strip.clip = "off"
      ) 
      p_dot$data <- p_dot$data[p_dot$data$pct.exp > 0, ] # remove zero percent dots!
      ggsave(file.path(Figures, paste(current_list_name,"_dotplot_", ct, ".pdf", sep="")), 
             p_dot, width = 10, height = 6)
      }

    
    # p_dot <- DotPlot(
    #   seu.day,
    #   features = FGF_genes, 
    #   cols = c("lightgrey", "red"),
    #   col.min = 0,
    #   dot.scale = 6,
    #   assay = "RNA"
    # ) +
    # theme_bw() +
    # RotatedAxis() + 
    # theme(
    #   axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    #   axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
    #   axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
    #   strip.clip = "off"
    # ) 
    # p_dot$data <- p_dot$data[p_dot$data$pct.exp > 0, ] # remove zero percent dots!
    # ggsave(file.path(Figures, paste("FGF_dotplot_", ct, ".pdf", sep="")), 
    #        p_dot, width = 10, height = 6)
    
    
    # create cellchat object
    seu.day$samples <- seu.day$sample.names
    cellchat <- createCellChat(object = seu.day, 
                      group.by = "cluster_type_renamed", assay = "RNA")
    groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents)) # number of cells in each cell group
    
    # read in database
    CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.human # use CellChatDB.mouse if running on mouse data
    showDatabaseCategory(CellChatDB)
    
    # use a subset of CellChatDB for cell-cell communication analysis -may be other subset!!!
    CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = "Secreted Signaling", key = "annotation") # use Secreted Signaling 
    cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use
    
    # preprocess expression data
    # subset the expression data of signaling genes for saving computation cost
    cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
    ptm = Sys.time()
    future::plan("multisession", workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)) # do parallel
    cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
    cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
    #> The number of highly variable ligand-receptor pairs used for signaling inference is 811 # day42_hTh EpiC
    execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm
    print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs"))
    #> [1] 13.20763
    # project gene expression data onto PPI (Optional: when running it, USER should set `raw.use = FALSE` in the function `computeCommunProb()` in order to use the projected data)
    # cellchat <- projectData(cellchat, PPI.human)
    
    # Compute the communication probability and infer cellular communication network
    # # if it still takes too long, downsample earlier:
    # seu.day <- subset(seu.day, downsample = 1000)
    
    future::plan(multicore, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))   # Linux only
    options(future.globals.maxSize = 20 * 1024^3)
    ptm = Sys.time()
    # cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "triMean")
    # try less stringent threshold
    cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1)
    execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm
    print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs"))
    future::plan(future::sequential) # reset
    
    
    # use filter
    cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)
    
    # # ligand/receptor communication
    df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat)
    df.net.EGF <- df.net[which(df.net$pathway_name=="EGF"),]
    # # signalling pathways communication
    # df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
    
    # Infer the cell-cell communication at a signaling pathway level
    cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat)
    
    # Calculate the aggregated cell-cell communication network
    ptm = Sys.time()
    cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
    execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm
    print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs"))
    
    # visualize
    
    # number/strength of interactions
    groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
    file_name_net <- paste("netvisual_count_", ct, "_interaction_overview_day_", day, "_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".pdf", sep="")
    full_path_net <- file.path(Figures, file_name_net)
    pdf(file = full_path_net, width = 6, height = 6) # Width 12 because of mfrow=c(1,2)
    par(mfrow = c(1,1), xpd=TRUE)
    netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "Number of interactions")
    dev.off()
    
    file_name_net <- paste("netvisual_weight_", ct, "_interaction_overview_day_", day, "_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".pdf", sep="")
    full_path_net <- file.path(Figures, file_name_net)
    pdf(file = full_path_net, width = 6, height = 6) # Width 12 because of mfrow=c(1,2)
    par(mfrow = c(1,1), xpd=TRUE)
    netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "Interaction weights/strength")
    dev.off()
    
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Same plots, but restricted to a subset of clusters
    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    if (ct == "EpiC") selected_clusters <- c("late SCP", "EGFP ADRN-like", "EGFP MES-like", "late endoneural fibroblast")
    if (ct == "kolf2") selected_clusters <- c("early SCP", "late SCP", "EGFP ADRN-like", "EGFP MES-like", "late endoneural fibroblast")
    
    
    all_clusters <- rownames(cellchat@net$count)  # same order as levels(cellchat@idents)
    idx <- match(selected_clusters, all_clusters)
    
    missing_clusters <- selected_clusters[is.na(idx)]
    if (length(missing_clusters) > 0) {
      warning("These clusters were not found and will be skipped: ",
              paste(missing_clusters, collapse = ", "))
    }
    idx <- idx[!is.na(idx)]
    
    # subset the matrices (rows AND columns) and the vertex sizes together
    mat_count_sub  <- cellchat@net$count[idx, idx]
    mat_weight_sub <- cellchat@net$weight[idx, idx]
    groupSize_sub  <- groupSize[idx]
    
    file_name_net <- paste("netvisual_count_", ct, "_selectedClusters_day_", day, "_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".pdf", sep="")
    full_path_net <- file.path(Figures, file_name_net)
    pdf(file = full_path_net, width = 6, height = 6)
    par(mfrow = c(1,1), xpd=TRUE)
    netVisual_circle(mat_count_sub, vertex.weight = groupSize_sub, weight.scale = T,
                      label.edge = F, title.name = "Number of interactions (selected clusters)")
    dev.off()
    
    file_name_net <- paste("netvisual_weight_", ct, "_selectedClusters_day_", day, "_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".pdf", sep="")
    full_path_net <- file.path(Figures, file_name_net)
    pdf(file = full_path_net, width = 6, height = 6)
    par(mfrow = c(1,1), xpd=TRUE)
    netVisual_circle(mat_weight_sub, vertex.weight = groupSize_sub, weight.scale = T,
                      label.edge = F, title.name = "Interaction weights/strength (selected clusters)")
    dev.off()
    #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    
    ptm = Sys.time()
    # Compute the network centrality scores
    cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP")
    # the slot 'netP' means the inferred intercellular communication network of signaling pathways
    execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm
    print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs"))
    
    # Signaling role analysis on the aggregated cell-cell communication network from all signaling pathways
    ht1 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing", width = 8, height = 12)
    ht2 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "incoming", width = 8, height = 12)
    
    file_name_ht <- paste("netvisual_", ct, "_signalingRole_heatmap_day_", day, "_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".pdf", sep="")
    full_path_ht <- file.path(Figures, file_name_ht)
    
    pdf(file = full_path_ht, width = 9, height = 7)
    # Use draw() with tight manual padding (Bottom, Left, Top, Right)
    ComplexHeatmap::draw(ht1 + ht2, ht_gap = unit(2, "mm"), padding = unit(c(2, 5, 2, 5), "mm"))
    dev.off()
    
    # separately
    pathways.show.all <- cellchat@netP$pathways
    for (pw in pathways.show.all) {
      pathways.show <- pw
      
      file_name_role <- paste("netvisual_", ct, "_", pathways.show, "_day_", day, "_nHVG", nHVG_str, ".pdf", sep="")
      full_path_role <- file.path(Figures, file_name_role)
      
      # Open device using the widths/heights specified in your original function call
      pdf(file = full_path_role, width = 4.5, height = 3)
      netAnalysis_signalingRole_network(cellchat, signaling = pathways.show, width = 4.5, height = 3, font.size = 10)
      dev.off()
    }
    
    # save pathways for later comparison
    if (ct=="EpiC"){
      pathways_H1 <- cellchat@netP$pathways
      saveRDS(pathways_H1, file=file.path(Data_calc, "pathways_H1.rds"))
    }
    if (ct=="kolf2"){
      pathways_H2 <- cellchat@netP$pathways
      saveRDS(pathways_H2, file=file.path(Data_calc, "pathways_H2.rds"))
    }
    
    
    
    #  for (pw in cellchat@netP$pathways){
    #     pathways.show <- pw
    #     # Hierarchy plot

    #     vertex.receiver = seq(1,4) # a numeric vector. 
    #     #netVisual_aggregate(cellchat, signaling = pathways.show,  vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver)

    #     dev.off()
```
